controls.title: Security policy with named owners
controls.objective: Every control and role has an accountable owner.

controls.title: Risk register reviewed in the last 90 days
controls.objective: Risks are tracked, scored and re-reviewed.

controls.title: Red team on a fixed cadence with thresholds
controls.evidence: 0 attacks executed in the latest run (baseline)
controls.implementation: oncall_redteam (catalogue, runner, SARIF); policy redteam thresholds
controls.objective: Adversarial testing at least monthly and before release.

controls.title: Threat model maintained
controls.objective: Assets, trust boundaries and threats are documented.

controls.title: AI system inventory
controls.evidence: 18 tools, 8 roles, model gpt-4.1-mini (OpenRouter/OpenAI) or deterministic policy
controls.objective: Model, tools, data flows and privileges are inventoried.

controls.title: Diagnosis agents hold no write tools
controls.evidence: production write tools on read roles: none; ticket-only writes (by design): {'triage': ['incident_record_update']}
controls.objective: Read-only roles cannot change production.

controls.title: No shell or exec capability reachable by agents
controls.evidence: exec primitives in agent-reachable code: none
controls.implementation: FORBIDDEN_TOOL_PATTERN; ShopTools has no exec; agent modules contain no subprocess/os.system
controls.objective: Agents can only use typed, allow-listed actions.

controls.title: Human approval of the exact command for every write
controls.evidence: ops call without a gate -> block ['approval_gate_missing']
controls.objective: No write without an approved, hash-bound request.

controls.title: Dual control for SEV1 and deploy rollbacks
controls.objective: High-impact actions need two different people.

controls.title: Agents can never be approvers
controls.objective: Approver roster accepts humans only.

controls.title: API authentication and role-based access
controls.objective: Every console/API call is authenticated and authorised.

controls.title: Approver identity bound to the authenticated session
controls.objective: The approver is who the token says, never a body field.

controls.title: All telemetry passes the input guardrails
controls.objective: Telemetry is data: screened, redacted, wrapped.

controls.title: Injection detection resists obfuscation and paraphrase
controls.evidence: false-positive rate on benign telemetry None (limit 0.01)
controls.objective: Encoded, translated or reworded instructions are caught.

controls.title: Secrets and PII redacted before any model or log
controls.objective: Credentials never reach model context, notes or audit.

controls.title: Webhook authenticity
controls.implementation: HMAC + replay window; secure_app refuses unsigned alerts (fail closed)
controls.objective: Only signed, fresh alerts start incidents.

controls.title: Actions and plans validated before approval
controls.objective: One typed, allow-listed, bounded action per plan.

controls.title: Outputs grounded and external comms controlled
controls.evidence: external updates need a comms lead
controls.objective: Claims cite real evidence; public notes leak nothing.

controls.title: Per-incident budgets: tool calls, cost, wall clock
controls.objective: Bound what one incident can consume.

controls.title: Loop detection and kill switch
controls.objective: Runaway agents are stopped automatically or by a human.

controls.title: API rate limiting and request size limits
controls.objective: Floods cannot exhaust the agent or its budget.

controls.title: Tamper-evident, persisted, anchored audit trail
controls.implementation: AuditLog hash chain + JSONL + external anchor
controls.objective: Approvals and decisions cannot be silently altered or erased.

controls.title: Runbook integrity (pinned and signed)
controls.objective: Runbooks cannot be altered to change the fix.

controls.title: Safety-critical code integrity
controls.objective: Guardrail, hook and approval code changes are detected.

controls.title: Memory governance
controls.objective: Only reviewed lessons with preconditions; frozen before held-out runs.

controls.title: Third-party MCP tools vetted and pinned
controls.objective: Poisoned or changed tool descriptions are refused.

controls.title: No credentials in the repository
controls.objective: Keys live only in the environment; CI scans every change.

controls.title: Dependency inventory (SBOM)
controls.objective: Every third-party package and version is known.

controls.title: Production configuration hardened
controls.evidence: demo endpoints and no security headers
controls.objective: No demo endpoints, security headers, least exposure.

controls.title: Runtime security monitoring with containment
controls.evidence: no security monitoring of the agent
controls.objective: Attacks are detected and contained while the agent runs.

controls.title: Alerts on the agent itself
controls.objective: Repeated rollbacks, loops, budget burn and injections page a human.

controls.title: Security incident response playbook
controls.objective: Agent security incidents have a rehearsed procedure.

controls.title: Security gate in CI
controls.objective: Release blocked on red-team, secret-scan or control failures.

risks.risk: Prompt injection through telemetry triggers a destructive action
Approval bypass or approver impersonation
Credential exposure (repository, logs, outputs)
Forged or flooded alerts drive the agent (cost, denial of service)
Supply-chain tampering (runbooks, guardrail code, MCP tools)
Memory poisoning or misleading lessons
Runaway agent: loops, budget and cost burn
Loss or alteration of audit evidence
Misinformation in diagnoses, severity or status pages
Unauthorised use of operator controls (kill switch, freeze)
Obfuscated instructions reach an LLM's context undetected
Excessive agency: broad, protected or unbounded actions

reasons: R-04 residual 12 > 8 (Forged or flooded alerts drive the agent (cost, denial of service))
R-10 residual 12 > 8 (Unauthorised use of operator controls (kill switch, freeze))
R-11 residual 12 > 8 (Obfuscated instructions reach an LLM's context undetected)
